description: Documented Coinbase transaction-summary response shape used by FeeManager.

response.total_fees: number - total fees across assets in USD for the filtered summary

fee_tier.aop_from: string - lower bound of the applicable pricing range
fee_tier.aop_to: string - upper bound of the applicable pricing range

volume_types: string - contributing volume type such as VOLUME_TYPE_SPOT or VOLUME_TYPE_US_DERIVATIVES

goods_and_services_tax.type: string - tax treatment such as INCLUSIVE

response.advanced_trade_only_volume: number - Advanced Trade volume in USD
response.advanced_trade_only_fees: number - Advanced Trade fees in USD
response.coinbase_pro_volume: number - Coinbase Pro volume in USD
response.coinbase_pro_fees: number - Coinbase Pro fees in USD
response.total_balance: string - total balance across spot, INTX, and FCM in USD
response.has_cost_plus_commission: boolean - whether cost-plus commission pricing applies
response.has_promo_fee: optional boolean - promotional-fee flag when supplied by Coinbase

fee_manager_consumption.future_validation: FUTURE/EXPIRING/FCM is accepted only when has_cost_plus_commission is true.
fee_manager_consumption.cache_scope: One immutable schedule per canonical product type: shared SPOT/CBE and shared FUTURE/EXPIRING/FCM.
fee_manager_consumption.failure_behavior: A failed filtered request retains that product type's last-known-good/default snapshot without overwriting the other cache.
fee_manager_consumption.quote_selection: post_only=true selects maker; post_only=false selects taker.
fee_manager_consumption.quote_telemetry: Public FeeQuote reports product type, liquidity assumption, exchange/validation rates, pricing tier, cost-plus state, promo state, source, and refresh time from one atomic snapshot.
